globex.definition: CME Globex electronic trading session for ES; session boundaries and any maintenance break must be confirmed from CME/provider instrument definitions before acquisition

rth.definition: US cash-equity regular trading hours, 13:30:00-20:00:00 UTC for the selected July 2026 dates; confirm exchange-calendar exceptions before acquisition

pre_rth.definition: same UTC calendar date before 13:30:00 UTC
pre_rth.use: retained for level construction only, not new eligibility

pdh_pdl.definition: prior completed RTH session high/low; source session is prior RTH, not a rolling 24-hour session

vah_val_poc.definition: value-area high, value-area low, and point of control calculated from the prior completed RTH volume-at-price profile using a fixed documented profile algorithm; source session is prior RTH

eligibility.application: prospective and study-scoped; do not modify unrelated strategies
